scope.authority_note: The April 2024 Regional IG excludes vaccine postmarketing reports; workbook VAERS-column rules are reported separately as profile=vaers.

highest_priority: D.1 missing FDA nullFlavor NA across registry/contracts/frontend/DB
FDA.G.k.10a nullFlavor NA has no persistence/API/XML/UI path
FDA.C.2.r.2.8 and C.2.r.2.7 XML telecom nullFlavor serialization violates FDA prefix requirements
FDA.G.k.12.r.4/.5 frontend omits existing backend nullFlavor fields
FDA.E.i.3.2h premarket always-NI rule is not correctly enforced

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 37
elements.official_condition: Required; boolean true/false or NI.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 52
elements.official_condition: When nullFlavor is used, telecom must also carry value="mailto" (without colon). MSK is forbidden for the US primary reporter in the VAERS profile.
notes: DB/API/import support the companion field, but the normal XML exporter ignores email_null_flavor and cannot emit the official nullFlavor form.
Exporter also does not emit the required value="mailto" discriminator.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 86
elements.official_condition: Conditional-required when FDA.C.5.5a exists; use NA when there are no cross-reported INDs.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 169
elements.official_condition: Required; when D.1 is NA/SUMMARY or AGGREGATE use NA.
notes: Official-guide ambiguity: Regional IG §4.2.4.1 says NI for unknown/unavailable race or ethnicity, but executable workbook row 169 excludes NI.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 170
elements.official_condition: Required; when D.1 is NA/SUMMARY or AGGREGATE use NA.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 185
elements.official_condition: For premarket safety reports the value must always be NI; postmarket is an outcome for device reports and medication errors.
notes: Case validator checks only the boolean value and does not pass required_intervention_null_flavor into the FDA required rule, so it does not implement the premarket always-NI rule correctly.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 271
elements.official_condition: For IND-exempt BA/BE when FDA.C.5.5b exists, coded value 1 or 2 identifies test/reference drugs; use NA for all other drugs or unavailable information.
notes: Dictionary and generated contract allow NA, but there is no nullFlavor companion in drug DB/model/API/XML/UI. Contract collector explicitly passes null for the nullFlavor path. Import/export read/write only @code.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 278
elements.official_condition: For combination products provide device brand/common name; either may be null, but if both are null FDA.G.k.12.r.6 is required.
notes: DB, Rust model, API, and XML support NI; frontend FdaDeviceInfo type, editor UI, and contract collector omit the nullFlavor path, so users cannot set or preserve it reliably.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 279
elements.official_condition: For combination products provide device brand/common name; either may be null, but if both are null FDA.G.k.12.r.6 is required.
notes: DB, Rust model, API, and XML support NI; frontend FdaDeviceInfo type, editor UI, and contract collector omit the nullFlavor path, so users cannot set or preserve it reliably.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 81
elements.official_condition: For FDA IND study reports, use Study ID$Abbreviated Trial Name; allowed nullFlavors remain ASKU/NASK.
notes: Allowed set matches. This audit did not re-test the separate Study ID formatting rule.

elements.official_location: FDA Core and Regional Data Elements and Business Rules v1.7, ICSR Data Elements row 88
elements.official_condition: Use NA where no patient is involved and for a single postmarket combination-product malfunction without AE; use SUMMARY for multiple malfunction reports; use AGGREGATE for premarket aggregate reports.
notes: Registry, generated contracts, frontend map, and DB omit FDA-added NA. The FDA no-patient scenario therefore cannot pass storage/contract validation even though business validation expects NA.

elements.official_condition: Required when E.i.3.2a indicates death; permitted set is unchanged.

official_ambiguities.workbook: Row 169 permits MSK, UNK, NA, OTH and excludes NI.
official_ambiguities.regional_guide: §4.2.4.1 says use NI when race or ethnic group is unknown/not available.
official_ambiguities.recommended_resolution: Treat workbook v1.7 as executable validator behavior, document the conflict, and confirm with FDA/AEMS before adding NI to race.

official_ambiguities.workbook: Row 49 Null Flag Applicable columns mark NI=Yes, MSK=Yes, ASKU=Yes, NASK=Yes, but Values Allowed text lists only MSK, ASKU, NASK.
official_ambiguities.recommended_resolution: Do not silently choose. Confirm with FDA validator/support; current repo follows Values Allowed and ICH set, excluding NI.

limits: No live submission was sent to the FDA validator. Conclusions use the current FDA-hosted April 2024 workbook and Regional IG plus static repository inspection.
VAERS-specific findings are identified but the April 2024 non-vaccine Regional IG itself excludes vaccine postmarketing reporting.
